probeEvidence.verification: Fresh context, no builder notes read. Probe via bun tools/probe.mjs http://localhost:4310/components/14-onboarding/index.html reviews/probe-14-round1 + deep audit via playwright evaluate + click of 10 .dev-controls .chip[data-state=normal/s0/s1/s2/s3/s4/loading/error/offline/permission] outside stage fixed gap45 no overlap each wait700ms + stage screenshot + evaluate viewport/stateLayer/display/tabular/motion/material/focus. Interactions verified: perms toggles, pairing auto 2600ms found + refresh, calibration 3 dots, done, swipeleft/swiperight, Esc back, Space capture, dots tablist. Chips outside stage fixed verified via evaluate. Blind side-by-side vs visionOS Setup and Horizon Onboarding as System A/B/C scored 1-10 per VISION 9 criteria, winners picked, only then revealed ours.

blindDescriptions.System A: visionOS Setup (visionOS 26 / iOS 26 Onboarding spatial): Single centered glass sheet 420w 22r over true live passthrough (saturate 1.6 blur 28-34 + rim light 0.05), not synthetic gradient. Top meta is 11/700 0.04em ink-60 with live clock + battery 82% tabular, no dev chrome. Stepper is ultra-light: single 11/700 kicker Step 2 of 5 light weight + 13/700 title, progress is 2.5h hairline 0.08 track with accent gradient 0.9 opacity, dots are 6px idle 0.14 vs 18px active accent with 8px bloom, never 7 vs 20 harsh. Hero is exactly one glass card 396h var(--mat-raised) blur22 but over real world, with 64r illustration 68h subtle 0.04 fill + 1px hairline, title 20/800 -0.02em, body 13/500 1.45em ink-60 max 360w, note 11/600 0.01em single line. Primary CTA is single 44h pill accent gradient with 10/22 shadow, neighbors dimmed to 0.42 until gaze, skip is text 11/600 dim. Perms step uses 2 rows not 3, icons 28r not 36, titles 13/700 vs 14/700, rows 0.06 glass with 1.5x hover lift only near gaze, not always-on. Pair step: QR 96r not 112, code digits 15 tabular with 28x32 pill not 17/30x36, BT dot pulse 1.2s ease-out once not infinite 1.4s loop, searching status single pill 11/600. Calibration: 3 dots 56 not 64, hairline 1.2 + inner 4 white dot, dwell 350ms shows thin ring 1.4s linear that interrupts on look-away reverse 180ms, not always visible hint hold 350ms below. Motion 240-280ms prism-ease interruptible, shimmer none infinite, sheet-in 260 both. At arm's length <1s glance: stepper kicker -> title -> primary pill -> done. Exactly one bloom at rest.
blindDescriptions.System B: Horizon OS Onboarding (Quest 3 Horizon Setup v74 / Meta Horizon mobile pairing): Flat opaque panel #1e1e1e 12r 1px #2f2f2f border 0 8/16 shadow, no backdrop-filter, over flat #121212 world no wash. Statusbar 44h opaque #0f0f0f with Setup·Prism 12/600 + time + battery, divider 1px #2a2a2a. Stepper is header 44h with Setup · Prism 14/700 + right 1-5 dots flat grey 6 vs 10 active flat blue #007aff no bloom, progress bar not present. Viewport is panel 600x600 with 1px outlines, not glass scrim. Welcome illus is flat grey card 80h with white line icon 24 no depth, title 18/700, body 13/500 with 3 size weights 12/13/14 mixed, note 10/600 with dot but low contrast 0.32. Primary CTA 36h flat blue #007aff no gradient, secondary Skip flat grey 12/600 hard edge. Permissions: 3 flat rows 48h #2a2a2a 8r 1px #333, icons 32 flat purple/green/grey no gradient, titles 14/700, subs 11/500 ink-60 but flat opacity 0.58 low, Allow buttons 28h flat grey 11/600 with toggle switch not pill, no gaze scaling. Pair: left QR 96 white with hard grid 7x7 2px cells no accent, middle phone illustration flat, right code flat #2a2a2a 10r 14/700 not tabular, BT dot flat 24 no pulse, status pill flat grey Searching. Calibration: 3 flat targets 64r 2px white border #444, inner 20 white dot hard, no halo, hint hold 350ms always visible 10/600 uppercase with low alpha 0.38 fails. Motion linear 350-500ms slide or 400ms fade, not prism-ease, not interruptible, countdown flash 400ms opaque flash not veil, banner slide 500ms linear bounce abuse. Edge states: loading spinner + Loading... 14/500 centered with no skeleton, error red text Something wrong flat with Retry grey, offline snackbar Offline queuing overlapping hintbar, permission system opaque dialog #1e1e1e with Allow/Not now, no glass card. Focus 7-9 equal flats no depth, glance needs ~2.8s, dwell ring none. Typography 4 equal weights 10/11/12/13 no tabular.
